connector.name: Warp Agent MCP
connector.registryDescription: Quote, book, and track LTL, FTL, cargo van, and box-truck freight via the Warp API.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.wearewarp.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package warp-agent-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the warpfreight account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: WARP_API_KEY
env.description: Warp API key (wak_live_* or wak_test_*). Optional — the package prefers ~/.warp/config.json populated by `warp-agent signup` or `warp-agent login`.

env.name: WARP_API_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://www.wearewarp.com/api/v1/warp (the warp-site proxy that accepts wak_* tokens). Set to https://gw.wearewarp.com/api/v1 for direct gateway access with a raw customer key.
